title: CONFRONTING THE CANON
description: Examines some of the canonical ideas and texts in the history of Western political thought.  Considers works by authors including Plato, Aristotle, Machiavelli, Hobbes, Locke, Rousseau, J.S. Mill, and Marx.  Describes and analyzes many of the key ideas that have shaped the Western political tradition, as well as critiques of them.
recommendations: PS 206; Critical thinking, reasoning, and synthesis skills
